title: Final Speed Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The final speed must be correctly calculated as v = 12.2 m/s.

title: Force Balance Setup
description: Important Criteria: The relationship F = aV must be correctly established and used.

title: Power Equation Use
description: Important Criteria: The use of the power equation FV = 600 W must be correctly applied.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The units for speed should be correctly identified as meters per second.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in the equations or calculations will lead to incorrect results.
